name: giljo-mcp-frontend
overridesComment: SEC-9287. Forces a single patched brace-expansion (5.0.8) into the dev toolchain.
WHY: CVE-2026-14257 (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, high) affects brace-expansion <=5.0.7 and is
patched ONLY on the 5.x line -- there is no fixed 1.x or 2.x release. Our tree reached it
through minimatch@3 (via eslint, @eslint/config-array, @eslint/eslintrc) and minimatch@9
(via editorconfig and js-beautify's nested glob), neither of which can resolve a fixed
brace-expansion inside its declared range. Pinning minimatch to 10.x collapses all four
copies to the one patched 5.0.8 and takes a full `npm audit --audit-level=high` to zero.
Dev toolchain only -- nothing here is bundled into the shipped frontend, and the CI gate
(`npm audit --omit=dev`) read zero both before and after.
CAVEAT: this is an UNSUPPORTED PAIRING. eslint 9.39.5 declares minimatch ^3.1.5, so 10.x is
seven majors past its stated range and no upstream project tests that combination. It was
verified working here (full lint, unit suite and build all green on Linux), but nothing binds
a future eslint 9.x or minimatch 10.x patch to keep it working. A lint failure mentioning
minimatch is the signal that this pin, not your code, is at fault.
DELETE THIS when eslint ships a minimatch >=10 dependency of its own (eslint 10 already does)
or when the toolchain otherwise stops resolving a vulnerable brace-expansion. Re-check with
`npm audit --audit-level=high` after removing it; if that reads zero, the pin is dead weight.
NOTE: the parallel js-beautify branch could not be closed by any version bump -- @vue/test-utils
2.4.11 (latest) declares js-beautify ^1.14.9 and the js-beautify fix is a 2.x major. This pin
sidesteps that by patching brace-expansion below it rather than bumping js-beautify.
@sentry/bundler-plugins: keeps ONE copy of @sentry/core in the shipped Sentry chunk.
WHY: @sentry/vite-plugin 5.4.0 (latest) is a pure re-export of @sentry/bundler-plugins/vite
but declares it at ^10.64.0, which drags @sentry/core 10.x to the top of node_modules. With
@sentry/vue 11 that forces npm to nest a private @sentry/core 11 under @sentry/vue, browser
and browser-utils, and Vite then bundles all three copies (Sentry chunk 149 kB -> 214 kB raw).
Pinning bundler-plugins to 11.x (same version train as the SDK) hoists a single core 11.
DELETE THIS when @sentry/vite-plugin publishes a release that depends on bundler-plugins 11+.
